title: A ride that ends in an adventure
hook: The best part of a ride is where it ends.
cta: Comment the adventure you want to try
caption: Some rides are about the road. Others are about where they end. Where should the next one end? Comment below.
altText: A 25-second reel from a motorcycle ride that ends at an adventure spot, with the route, the ride time and one practical tip on screen.

notes: Waiting on you: which route, and whether you have usable footage. Once you say the route, the beats get the real place name and ride time instead of the brackets, and this goes to review. Keeping your bike content in week one is deliberate — the account turns toward adventure travel without dropping what your current followers follow you for.
